description: This file defines the FooTable.Export component for the FooTable jQuery plugin, providing export functionalities such as JSON and CSV export of table data, and extends column data stringification methods.

classes.name: F.Export
classes.description: Component providing export functionalities for FooTable, including JSON and CSV export, and snapshot management.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the export component, creating a snapshot of table rows before paging.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Captures the current rows as a snapshot before filtering and sorting are applied.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Returns an array of column definitions excluding internal columns.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Returns table rows as objects, optionally filtered.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns table data as a JSON object with columns and rows.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Returns table data as a CSV formatted string.
